rationale.tabs: Used to associate detected media and navigation metadata with the active Firefox tab.
rationale.cookies: Used when the user explicitly sends a selected download with the browser session required by that URL.
rationale.contextMenus/menus: Legacy Firefox action surface; both permissions are currently declared and any reduction requires authoritative AMO compatibility review.
rationale.activeTab: Legacy manifest declaration retained pending authoritative AMO compatibility review; broad tabs and host access already exist.
rationale.webRequest/webRequestBlocking: Required by the legacy Firefox media detector and browser-download interception path.
rationale.*://*/*: Required by the legacy detector to observe HTTP(S) download and media responses across sites.
